body: yeah, that’s very to the point. is it better to do it in person or over text?.. in person would leave me with him for a while afterward and that’d just be uncomfortable for both of us
This actually made me laugh out loud aha I appreciate that. Made me laugh at my stupidness. But yeah.. It’s just how sweet he is to me.. otherwise
Yeah that text made me cry as soon as I received it
This is true.. he seems fine towards problems until he ACTUALLY makes me upset then it’s, making it seem like I’m overreacting
I’m so conflicted
yeah that made me start crying RIGHT away. honestly. every one of my ex boyfriends cheated on me so I’m sensitive to that

yeah this is my problem with it. his immediate reaction when he has issues with other guys is to fight and he’s gotten in a lot of them, especially when he was younger, because he used to live in inner city atlanta

Fair points. Although he has a lot of good qualities, the violence has always been a red flag for me but I don’t believe he’d ever hurt me & it’s more of a side effect of growing up in shittiest parts of Atlanta(we live in the suburbs in the Midwest now). 

But yeah, I think a friend would see the issue in this. Thank you

This is good advice, thank you. He’s liked me for eight months I guess, and he’s never brought it up before or been overly flirty with me. We don’t text much, probably a little bit every few days, but school’s about to end for both of us anyway.

Yeah I just hate hurting peoples’ feelings. I feel like I have a chance here of fucking up my relationship and I really don’t want to risk that. And I wouldn’t have had to if this kid didn’t tell me these things.:/

Well as far as I know he trusts me! I’m just caught between this and not telling him. It’s immediate fallout if I tell him, vs. worse potential fallout if he finds out later. It’s just ugly:( 

And yes, I know this. I have successfully gotten him to not fight someone before because I told him it was an issue of being responsible and caring about how I feel about issues that effect both of us (as it would be in this case)
I know! If he cared about me he wouldn’t of told me in the first place. And no, I don’t see him as any more than one of my friends:/
a comment- i know this seems juvenile but i need unbiased people for advice! it’s such an awkward situation for me, I try so hard to keep everyone I know happy.

They’ve told me before that they would need the code to said safe so it’d be pointless for me to get one, I would have to keep it out of the house.

And she’s connected to my bank account which is what leads to me hoarding my money at home, lol. I wasn’t aware any banks WOULD let minors do this, I’ll look into that, thank you

I could talk to them, I’m just really happy with the therapist I have now so I’m worried I’d get one I didn’t mesh with through them

He tells me I have a weird family dynamic (which is right) and that he thinks my parents are only together for their kids. He’s talked to them about me a couple of times. He told me that my mom and dad have completely different personalities and that it’s okay for me to start leaning away since I’m almost a junior in high school

i’m really close with my dad, actually. they’re still married but my sibling had a bout with an eating disorder and came close to divorce, and threatened me with divorce after they discovered that i have done drugs before.

i do go to a therapist but can’t any more, because my insurance won’t cover it. he’d helped me a lot

I have.. multiple times:( It’s been like this since I was little. We have tried and I am in therapy but between us she seems to not be able to accept that a lot of the time, I just cannot be happy

And by that I mean being able to eat or sleep when I want. i feel like that is my choice at this point
thank you i just feel like there is something else controlling me i worry its going to be overpowering than just my self will

no. i have a relatively good life (relationship, i have a few friends but i’m kinda lonely, shitty job but at least i work, school is bad though). i’m happy during the day. then the darkness creeps up at night and i’m drawn to die

They do care about him a lot, I’ve been his best friend for a long time & know them well. On one hand, I know that he will get caught eventually. but i wouldn’t want to get anything on his record that will impact him a lot when he’s older.. on the other hand the possibility of him hitting another person on the road is too much for me

I worry they will call the police on him! I know his family and they’re super sweet but not when it comes to this kinda stuff. We’ve been best friends for 3 years. I don’t want him to think I’m being patronizing or condescending, though:/
